all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] The assertion `strings.Contains(errOut, "mock")` is always true for these fixtures: record-lenses prints `record-lenses: --from-run %q: %v`, and both run IDs ("mockinit", "mocktainted") contain "mock". Any exit-2 rejection passes — wrong diff, unreadable init, non-passing outcome, missing run — and the check cannot tell which new branch fired. If a fixture later broke, or the rejection came from another check, the test would still pass without proving the mock-init and mock-taint branches work. Match the specific messages or use run IDs that don't contain "mock".

rejected.desc: [ADVISORY] The mock rejection runs only in record-lenses; the gate does not re-check a stored marker's FromFSMRunID. A subagent-adjudicated marker recorded under 0.13.4 from a mock run still satisfies pr-ready/task-done/epic-ready after upgrading while base..HEAD is unchanged. A gate already holding a marker from a mock run keeps passing until the next commit or base change invalidates it, and nothing tells upgraders.
